notes.title: Concursion Featured in Humble Weekly Bundle!!
notes.content:
Holy poopsmith! Have you heard?

Concursion is currently in this week's [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/weekly]Humble Weekly Bundle[/url]!!

We, along with all our Mastertronic-published bro-friends are sharing a [b]Pay What You Want Bundle[/b] for Seven Whole Days!

That means, for the price of your choice (a penny, a dollar, or a novelty oversized plastic check), you get 14 games, all at once, to gorge yourself upon. (We're hoping for the giant check...)
Steam Keys, DRM-Free downloads... [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/weekly]whatever you like[/url].

Plus, a share of the proceeds go to some [url=http://www.specialeffect.org.uk]awesome[/url] [url=http://www.gamesaid.org]charities[/url].

In celebration of this (we think) momentous occasion, we think it's a good time to hype our FIRST TRAILER for our upcoming game... [b]"The Weaponographist"[/b]!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UPjCoF2B7No]A Trailer, I Said![/url]

As you can probably tell, this is a pretty cool day for us.

Hooray!
Dann0

notes.title: A Contest! A Sale! A Demo!
notes.content:
Hi again all,

[h1]A Sale![/h1]
Did you all know that Concursion goes on sale, for a full week, starting today?? That's so many games per money. Like... all the games per money!

[h1]And A Demo!![/h1]
I'm also very happy to say that, after a bunch of weeks debating whether we'd have one... We decided it's much more [i]fun[/i] to have a demo!!

The Concursion demo features content not found within the game proper, a leaderboard to sprint against, and even two little achievements!
It's not Huge... But we think it's pretty fun.
(And my thumb really hurts, right now, from racing it...)

[h1]And A Contest! Win the game!![/h1]
Also! For the [b]first week[/b] of this demo's release, to coincide with this week's [b]Steam Sale[/b], we decided to see just how fast people could go. From today, Monday, through to Monday morning (PST), the leaderboards are fair game.

The [b]Top Ten scorers[/b] on the scoreboard, this week only, will each win [b]free copies[/b] of Concursion itself. All seventy gooey delicious levels.

[h1]So, race![/h1]
Try the demo, run real fast, and tell a friend.
Free swag is best swag!

Hooray!
Dann0


UPDATE: Increased the number of prizes to TEN!

notes.title: Version Update Today!
notes.content:
Well hello there!

For the last few weeks, you may have noticed small little updates to Concursion here and there. We've been quietly tweaking some minor things behind the scenes, listening to feedback, and squashing just a handful of bugs we've found.

Today's a beautiful push day!!

Includes are
* Added an input buffer for jumping, if you jump before hitting the ground (really small time period, though).
* Streamlined some Bosses attack patterns to make them repeat less.
* Modified the health drops in Boss 1 and Boss 2 when playing on "Normal" mode.
* Fixed some hitboxes, especially in Boss 5 and some minor enemies.
* Fixed a bug wherein Boss 5 could be made to stop attacking, if you attacked him at Exactly the right time.

Huzzah! Stuff! Often nearly invisible stuff!
Hooray!   ;)

-Dann0

notes.title: Concursion Speedrun Challenge and Giveaway
notes.content:
This [b]Thursday, July 10th at 5:00 PDT[/b], the guys from Puuba are going to battle. Head-to-head, every act, we'll be livestreaming a full length speedrun of Concursion, for as long as it may take.

Choose a side, either TeamDave or TeamDanny, and cheer for them to win. The winning team will be raffling off copies of Concursion to their side only.

BUT!
We'll also be giving away copies of Other People's games!! Every time we beat an act, copies of other awesome games will be showered like candy. 0RBITALIS, Tango Fiesta, 10 Second Ninja, and more.

A vertiable cornucopia of prizes and trash talk and fun.

The event will be broadcast at [url=twitch.tv/puubadanny]twitch.tv/puubadanny[/url] on [b]Thursday, July 10th[/b], at 5PM Pacific.

Be there... or...
Please be there!
